name: What permits are needed in Pasadena versus Los Angeles for a gut renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do permit requirements differ between Pasadena and the City of Los Angeles for full gut renovations?
mainEntity.text: How do permit requirements differ between Pasadena and the City of Los Angeles for full gut renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: The basic permit logic is similar in Pasadena and the City of Los Angeles: if the project changes structure or building systems, permits are usually required. The difference is often in how each city reviews plans, schedules inspections, and applies local rules. Pasadena may add more formal fee schedules and, in some neighborhoods, additional review for historic or sensitive properties. Los Angeles projects can also face detailed plan-check requirements depending on scope, property type, and location. Homeowners should not assume that a permit strategy that worked in one city will work in the other. The best approach is to confirm jurisdiction early, review local submittal requirements, and ask whether the project will need separate approvals for structural, mechanical, electrical, or historic review. That early clarification helps prevent redesign and resubmittals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permit needs are similar in principle in both cities because structural, electrical, plumbing, gas, and HVAC work usually requires approval. The difference is often in local review, fee schedules, plan-check timing, and historic or special district rules. Pasadena can be more procedural for certain residential projects.
